lines: Three primary powers of the Lord:
unsurpassable-will-awakening — that triad a i u.
From this triad every play of powers is carried.
Unsurpassable: rest is bliss. Rest in will: rulership.
Awakening's rest: the wave. Action-power's onset
is that triad ā ī ū.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra mukhyās tāvat tisraḥ parameśvarasya śaktayaḥ anuttarecchonmeṣa iti tad eva parāmarśatrayam a i u iti etasmād eva tritayāt sarvaḥ śaktiprapañcaḥ caryate anuttara eva hi viśrāntir ānandaḥ icchāyām eva viśrāntiḥ īśanam unmeṣa eva hi viśrāntir ūrmiḥ yaḥ kriyāśakteḥ prārambhaḥ tad eva parāmarśatrayam ā ī ū iti
